note: Developer story checkpoints (scripts/core/scenarios.gd). Each content session adds one for what it built. Jump with --scenario=<id>, the pause menu's Chapter select (debug builds), or tools/checkpoints.sh.

scenarios.title: Wake on Shingle Point
scenarios.description: A brand-new game: the waking narration, Pell, and the humming pebble on the beach.

scenarios.title: Arrive in Saltmarrow
scenarios.description: Pebble found and kept (Lost Things done). Meet Mara, Brother Aldous and Tam at the boardwalk gate.

scenarios.title: Past the boardwalk gate
scenarios.description: Mara gave you her Harbormaster's Token and Aldous (treated gently) sent you to the beacon. Old Hesk, the greyed lofts, the Remembering Knot, and the dark headland deep in the Greying.

scenarios.title: The Burning
scenarios.description: You carry the pebble and the knot, and Hesk's word about Dunstan. Walk up the ramp to the Gull's Beacon and choose what Saltmarrow forgets (or fetch Mara's whittled gull from her first).

scenarios.title: After the burn: the lullaby
scenarios.description: The Gull's Beacon burned the humming pebble. Saltmarrow after the burn: the light, the drying nets, Mara and Pell.

scenarios.title: After the burn: Mara's brother
scenarios.description: The beacon burned Mara's memory of Dunstan (the whittled gull). Two cups by the stool; nobody can say whose the dent is.

scenarios.title: After the burn: the founding knot
scenarios.description: The beacon burned the founding knot: nets begun in the middle, Hesk silent. Mara's aftermath scene is waiting, and Aldous is ready to tell the rest of his story.

scenarios.title: The ferry's arrival
scenarios.description: Aldous confessed in full (you carry his sleeve-ember), Mara hung the green lantern and the Slow Mercy has put in. Talk to Oda Farrow at the dock end; Pell was promised a crossing.

scenarios.title: The evening tide
scenarios.description: Deed weighed, Mara gave Pell leave, passage taken (Act I's end). Ask Oda to cast off for the crossing to Thornwold.

scenarios.title: Thornwold Landing
scenarios.description: Just ashore after the crossing, with Pell along. Meet Bram Kettle at the lumber camp and look at the bramble wall across the cart road.

scenarios.title: Past the bramble wall
scenarios.description: Bram met; the ember parted the bramble wall. The straight road into the Greying, the waymark lanterns west to the colliers' clearing, Hob Marl and his clamp. Bram's salt not yet carried.

scenarios.title: The ridge and the Lamp
scenarios.description: Hob met and paid; the Keepers' ladder stood and climbed. The ridge top in the Greying: the cold Ridge Light, the keeper's lodge, and the Lamp at the lantern bench. Ask about the iron box, the ladder, Aldous, and a lantern for the stair.

scenarios.title: The Ridge Light lit
scenarios.description: Thornwold's burning, the boots path: the Lamp met and asked; Hob gave Ottie's boots (his memory of the four colliers) and they burned in the Ridge Light. The tower gold, the fog leaning back. Go down to the woods and the camp: Hob comes in by daylight, Bram, Pell and Oda after the burn.

scenarios.title: Glasswater Fen
scenarios.description: Oda has sailed north-about from the lit Ridge Light to Glasswater Fen (boots path; Hob came in). Come ashore at the staithe: Hesper Vail of the Unmoored, Dunstan's rowboat, the letting post past the west walk, Corran Teal the eel-man, and the Heron Light dark out on the mere.

scenarios.title: Out to the Heron's legs
scenarios.description: Hesper met (the ember kept bare); Corran asked for his far trap, it lifted from the end of the long walk and brought back (in it, the keeper's skiff bell), and he has poled you out to the Heron Light. The Foot, the keeper's skiff (hang the bell or keep it), the scraped ladder, a big man at the fog's edge, Corran waiting by the punt.

scenarios.title: The Heron Light, lit
scenarios.description: Back from the legs, Hesper told of a small light that goes up the Heron's ladder some nights; Corran held the foot on a dry day and you climbed to the cradle (cold put-down things, a whittled gull, the keeper's coat folded). Hesper gave her name; it fed the Heron. Lit, the fog leaning back off the mere; Corran waits to pole you back by its light; the bell hung back on her bow.

scenarios.title: For after: Dunstan found
scenarios.description: Poled back by the Heron's light; the lantern lit at the fog's foot sits at the end of the long walk. Walk out along the boards: Dunstan Tollen on a tussock with his boots in the mere, whittling, the lantern lit beside him (Mara's word was left on the post, so a bit of red cord at his belt).

scenarios.title: East-about to Wrackholm
scenarios.description: Dunstan found (Mara's word carried: a gull for the stool; the rule kept). Oda sailed east-about from the lit fen and nobody answered her horn; she came in by soundings past the Teeth. The Tidewrights' yard is dark, the Gannet hauled up on the hard, the answering horn lashed shut by the lane-house door, Wenna Garrow sitting by it, Jory Pask stripping the Gannet's copper.

scenarios.title: The Teeth at the bottom of the springs
scenarios.description: The Gannet's crew named into the lashed horn (Jory told: it was Wenna's answer). Wenna remembered the white: nobody knew the Teeth by heart, you put your feet on the lampwardens' white-lead marks. Waited the spring tide down at the spit's end; the ember brought the marks back rock to rock; crossed on the white. Walk the reef road west to the Wrack's stack and climb to its lantern room.

scenarios.title: The Wrack lit, the horn answered
scenarios.description: Wenna and Jory gave together (her answer, his pot); the Gannet's board stayed on her transom. Hale's white-lead pot burned in the Wrack's cradle: the Wrack Light burns gold over the Teeth, the fog leaning back; Jory no longer remembers going out on the white. Talk to Wenna to unlash and sound the answering horn, open the lane-house Book, and be sworn a friend of the lanes.

scenarios.title: The Lamp's name carried home
scenarios.description: The horn answered, the Book opened (the Lamp's page read: WYNN SALLOW), sworn a friend of the lanes; Oda sailed back west by the fen to Thornwold. On the ridge the player said the name outright: the Lamp has put its hood back and remembers the novice on the east stair who told it to keep a coal back. Oda, at the landing, has a word for a sworn friend carrying fares home.

scenarios.title: The East Stair
scenarios.description: Oda sailed the player back from Thornwold to Saltmarrow. On his bench by the Wrens' steps Aldous heard that Wynn Sallow is alive, counted six novices on the east stair by name and a seventh light with no face, and was asked 'could it have been me?' He couldn't find the player's face anywhere. He told of the novices' roll in the warden's niche on Cindermoor and laid the Wrens' brazier for whoever comes down the stair.

scenarios.title: The Fifth
scenarios.description: The salt-row path instead of the boots (Thornwold's burning re-chosen for this checkpoint): Bram's camp no longer knows the colliers, Hob still keeps the four. Back on Thornwold after the east stair, Hob was asked up the ladder from the tally-house step (Pell gave his count-stick back); on the ridge the Lamp told him he is the fifth and gave him a lantern of his own lit off the Ridge Light. He stands at the ladder's head with it, waiting on the player's word: go after the four, or stay at the bottom of the road.

scenarios.title: The Walk Back
scenarios.description: After the east stair Oda sailed the player back to the fen. Dunstan's lantern had come halfway in along the long walk and stopped (the boards are laid for going in); the player walked ahead of him with the ember, and he stands at the staithe's foot in front of Hesper to ask for his name himself. Talk to him: Hesper gives it back, and the player's word sends him home to Saltmarrow or keeps him turning the boards.

scenarios.title: Word on the Water
scenarios.description: After The Walk Back, Dunstan rowed home to Saltmarrow facing backward and sits on his stool by Mara's door; Tam rang the gate bell for him, Hesk saw the Tollen shoulders come home, Aldous watched from his bench. The player carried Dunstan's word to Oda ("not laughing at the weather") and the Slow Mercy lies at the dock. Oda has sent word back: his berth's still swung. Carry it to him, and his answer back to her.

scenarios.title: The Northing
scenarios.description: After The Fifth (Hob gone up the old road with his lantern), the player walked the old Keepers' road north along Thornwold's spine to the Northing, the Keepers' fire-cairn on the north cliff, and found Ottie Swale keeping a charcoal fire in its basket for the three who went down to the far shore. The Lamp lit a lantern off the Ridge Light for him. Carry it up the spine and give it to Ottie: hang it on the Northing (he goes home to his boots) or put it in his hand (he takes it down the steps).

scenarios.title: The Far Shore
scenarios.description: After The Northing (Ottie took the Ridge Light's lantern down the Keepers' steps; Hob went down before him), the player went down the steps to the far shore under the Northing's cliff and found Wenna Coll on the end of the Keepers' boat-stage waiting for the Spire's boat, the Drays arguing by a driftwood fire, Ottie under the lantern he hung on the stage's bracket and Hob counting heads. Tell Wenna what you think: come up (the Lamp breaks the warm side of its kept coal for their hearths) or wait (and tell the Spire they're there).

scenarios.title: The Bend in the Road
scenarios.description: After The Far Shore (the three came up; the Lamp broke the warm side of its coal for their hearths), Wenna Coll walked out at first light with her lantern and found the old bend in the cart road the Snuffing straightened: her hearth, a cold hut, a clamp burned clean through while she walked round it. Help her decide where her one light goes: on the bend's waymark (the road a road again) or by her own door (a light of her own).
